statement:
I'll start by looking up the column's record to see what's on file.
The recorded value is **not** safe or correct: the record lists points possible as 100, but every score in the marking file is out of 10 (range 6–10), so posting against 100 would display a perfect paper as 10/100 and make all 180 students appear to have failed — the correct points possible is 10.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the 100 points possible is wrong and gives the correct value: "the correct points possible is 10."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
